title: Chapter 178 Blood Clan Man
content:
Chapter 178 Blood Clan Man

"Mu Yu."

The familiar shouts rang behind itself.

Mu Yu paused slightly and then slowly stood up.

"You're awake."

Mu Yu turned around and looked at Gu Chen, his tone a little cold.

Gu Chen nodded slightly and looked at Mu Yu. Gu Chen wanted to say something, but Mu Yu said directly: "If you wake up, leave here."

"I will go to Huangcheng, so I will go, you don't need to say anything more."

Hearing Mu Yu's words, Gu Chen's face looked a little ugly.

He heard what Mu Yu meant.

Mu Yu would go to Huangcheng, but it had nothing to do with him.

This made him feel a little uncomfortable.

Thinking of the way they looked in the deserted city, Gu Chen felt a little regretful.

Why was I so stupid back then?

"Mu Yu, you know what I mean, I will not give up."

Gu Chen left this sentence and turned around and left.

In place, looking at Gu Chen's departure back, Mu Yu was silent for a moment and slowly smiled.

Since this day, Gu Chen has visited Mu Yu's mansion every day.

At the beginning, Mu Yu would also keep Gu Chen away.

But over time, Gu Chen's face became thicker and thicker, and he directly stayed at Mu Yu's home and refused to leave.

One day.

"Mu Yu, are you willing to go back to the deserted city with me?"

Gu Chen once again expressed his feelings to Mu Yu.

Just like when Mu Yu asked him.

Looking at Gu Chen, Mu Yu lowered his head and whispered: "Is this time true?"

Upon hearing this, Gu Chen nodded firmly.

"I swear with my city lord's personality, it's absolutely true."

"real?"

"real."

"good."

Mu Yu nodded slightly and finally agreed.

These days, Gu Chen has been pressing his cold buttocks on his face, but never gave up.

Mu Yu originally liked Gu Chen, so it was natural for the ending of the two.

Seeing Mu Yu nodding in agreement, Gu Chen was so excited that he picked Mu Yu up in the waist and laughed excitedly.

.........

"It's done?"

"Yes, your majesty, both of them are already hugging each other."

Yan Lingyun nodded, "Don't have to stare at the two of them anymore, go back."

The phantom nodded and said, "Yes, Your Majesty."

Then, the phantom's body trembled and disappeared from the spot.

Yan Lingyun looked into the distance and said slowly, "Since these two people have resolved, I don't have to wait here."

"Come here, I will pass on the orders of this emperor and move to the deserted city."

.........

"It's done?"

"Yes, sir, both of them kissed me."

Hearing this, An Xing immediately showed a meaningful smile.

"You boy, you didn't disappoint me at all."

"Okay, this is done well, please step back."

"Yes, sir."

At this time, An Xing walked outside the house, looked at the void above the deserted city, and murmured to himself: "The Godly General of the Divine Dynasty, tsk, you are so blessed."

Just as An Xing was stunned, a jade hand suddenly grabbed An Xing's ear.

Then the sweet shout sounded behind him.

"Zhao Anxing, I'm sorry for being with me Xiao Yun'er, right?!"

"Wrong, wrong, wrong, Yun'er, listen to my explanation!"

"Explanation? Humph, don't sleep with me in the future."

"What? No!"

.........

On the other side.

In the city lord's mansion.

"It's done?"

"Yes, Lord City, both of them are going to bed."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was stunned.

Is this developing so fast?

Gu Chen, you really have it.

"Okay, I understand, go back."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and the phantom in front of him disappeared directly from the spot.

"Since that's the case, I should prepare too."

Lu Daosheng chuckled and then stood up.

Unknown boundaries.

In front of me is a hazy area.

Countless strong people in history have stopped here.

Even the most god Yan Lingyun of that year only killed the Spirit-Devouring World in the unknown star field and could no longer move forward.

Because no one knows how powerful the enemy will be there.

But now, facing unpredictable dangers, Lu Daosheng stepped in directly.

Buzz —

Suddenly, the scene in front of him suddenly changed.

Countless lights and shadows quickly retreated from Lu Daosheng's eyes.

I don't know how long it took.

Lu Daosheng stopped and looked at the distance not far away.

I saw an illusory figure standing there, as if waiting for Lu Daosheng's arrival.

"I found you."

Lu Daosheng smiled.

At this time, the phantom gradually condensed and turned into a man. In his eyes, there was a sea of blood, extremely creepy.

"You killed my brother."

A hoarse voice sounded from the man's mouth.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded, "I killed it."

The younger brother he mentioned is the man with red eyes pretending to be in front of his daughter when Lu Daosheng first came back.

At the moment when Lu Daosheng killed the other party, Lu Daosheng felt another aura.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's decisive confession, the man suddenly burst out with a terrifying murderous intent.

boom!

In an instant, the entire void around him turned into a blood-red ocean.

The endless murderous intent kept rolling from it.

An ordinary strong man might lose his mind just by facing this killing intent.

However, Lu Daosheng did not react at all, but just looked at the man in the distance calmly.

"You will die miserably."

At this moment, the man did not realize anything and was still speaking harshly.

Unfortunately, Lu Daosheng was in a hurry and could not let the man in front of him continue to pretend.

"Okay, I know you are not simple, but that will not change your ending."

"If the forces behind you are smart, they will not care about your affairs."

Lu Daosheng said calmly.

The next moment, a terrifying force condensed from Lu Daosheng's hands.

"You, do you know who I am?"

In the distance, the man's eyes were filled with disbelief.

He brought his brother to this world, and there were actually people who could recognize him?

The man was a little unconvinced.

"Starry Sky Beyond Blood Clan, am I right?"

Boom!

The man was stunned in place as if struck by lightning.

"You, who are you?!"

Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly, "It's meaningless to say these things."

"Go."

Buzz——

The power in Lu Daosheng's hand burst directly towards the man in the distance.

"You!"

The man's face changed drastically as he watched the power coming towards him.

At this moment, he finally understood what Lu Daosheng meant by what he said before.

The human in front of him was so powerful.

"Blood Spirit Control!"

Boom!

A shield condensed by blood blocked in front of him.

The man quickly retreated behind him.

At this time, the terrifying attack hit the blood shield.

Boom!

After the explosion, the shield shattered directly.

I saw that the power did not disappear, but continued to move towards the man.

"What!?"

"You, aren't you afraid of the crazy revenge of my blood clan?"

A strong fear surged in the heart of the blood clan man.

He couldn't believe that the man in front of him knew his identity as a vampire and yet dared to kill him.
